red_timestring.pro


Routines

top source red_timestring

CRISP pipeline

result = red_timestring(t [, Nsecdecimals=integer], short=short [, /interval])

Make a string representation of time in seconds since midnight.

Return value

A string on the form hh:mm:ss.[ddd...], where

Parameters

t in type=double

Keywords

Nsecdecimals in optional type=integer default=5

Use this number of decimals for the seconds.

short
interval in optional type=boolean

Set this keyword to interpret t as a time interval, producing a different type of string.

Author information

Author:

Mats Löfdahl

History:

2016-09-22 : MGL. First version, based on red_time2double. Specify number of decimals by using keyword. Allow to wrap to day(s) before (negative numbers) or day(s) after (large numbers).

2016-11-16 : MGL. New keyword short.

2016-11-28 : MGL. New keyword interval.
